# CASE abort_cleanup_nested_loop expect=fire
async def a1(batches):
    for batch in batches:
        results = await asyncio.gather(*(read(x) for x in batch))
        if failed(results):
            for r in results:
                await rollback(r)
            raise RuntimeError("failed")


# CASE early_exit_nested_loop expect=fire
async def a2(groups):
    for group in groups:
        for item in group.items:
            await save(item)
        if await done(group):
            return group
    return None


# CASE list_comp_nested_list_literal expect=fire
async def a3(items):
    return [[await read(x), x] for x in items]


# CASE list_comp_nested_list_literal_filter expect=fire
async def a4(items):
    return [[await read(x)] for x in items if x]
